_provenance: Recorded from repo state at git commit 9b173e95307b6af4335d46518f703265a9608d57, by reading scripts/train_two_tower.py, retrieval/two_tower.py, and output/full_retrieval/*. Not re-run, not re-derived.

training.scheduler: WarmupLinear (sentence-transformers fit() default, never overridden in train_two_tower.py)
training.warmup_steps_source: sentence-transformers SentenceTransformer.fit() default; NOT explicitly passed by scripts/train_two_tower.py
training.seed_note: No torch/numpy/random seed is set anywhere in scripts/train_two_tower.py. Confirmed by grep -- no seed/manual_seed/random_state token found in the file.
training.evaluator_note: fit() called with no evaluator argument; save_best_model=True (fit() default) has no effect without an evaluator.
training.training_steps_note: num_training_pairs // batch_size (drop_last=True), single epoch. 5147 < warmup_steps(10000) -> LR schedule never leaves the warmup ramp for the entire training run; final-step LR multiplier = 5147/10000 = 0.5147, i.e. ~1.03e-5 instead of the target 2e-5, and no decay phase is ever reached.
training.item_text_construction: product_title + ' ' + product_description + ' ' + product_bullet_point (NaN filled as empty string), concatenated with no field prefixes/separators

serving.embedding_normalization: normalize_embeddings=True on both item and query encode calls (retrieval/two_tower.py: encode_texts() and search_tt_global()) -- confirmed CONSISTENT between item/query paths; IndexFlatIP over L2-normalized vectors is mathematically equivalent to cosine similarity.

evaluation.recall_at_k_definition: macro-average (unweighted mean) of per-query recall = |relevant items ranked <= k| / |relevant set|, over queries with a non-empty relevant set for the given label key. Reused verbatim from scripts/evaluate_full_retrieval.py:recall_at_k().
evaluation.note: This is the FULL-CATALOG RETRIEVAL pipeline (BM25/Two-Tower/RRF, Recall@K). It is a SEPARATE experimental setting from the FIXED-CANDIDATE reranking pipeline (MLP/LambdaMART, NDCG@K) audited previously in experiments/audit/. This project does not merge the two, and this experiment stays entirely within the full-catalog retrieval setting except where Phase 11 (semantic_score ablation) explicitly operates in the fixed-candidate setting, clearly labeled as such.
